name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days, where he studied Mechanical Engineering. He spent countless hours tinkering with go-karts and participating in local racing events. After graduation, he landed a junior engineer position at a local tuning shop specializing in performance vehicles, honing his skills in diagnostics and performance optimization. His dedication and sharp analytical mind quickly caught the attention of Lechner Racing, where he has since become a valued member of the engineering team.

Ahmad is known for his meticulous approach to race preparation and his ability to stay calm under pressure. He excels at data analysis and translating complex technical information into actionable strategies for the driver. He believes that a strong relationship between engineer and driver is essential for success, and he strives to build trust and open communication with his drivers. His ambition is to one day lead an engineering team to a championship victory.

What sets Ahmad apart is his ability to quickly identify and resolve mechanical issues, often improvising solutions in high-pressure situations. His calm demeanor and technical expertise make him a valuable asset during races.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on double-checking all calculations, even after they've been verified by others.
